name: UK FCA Regulatory Passport
statute: UK Financial Conduct Authority — FSMA 2000 / FCA Authorization
target_buyer: Israeli fintech, payments, crypto, and AI companies expanding to the UK

icp.company_size: Any size — startups to Series B+
icp.trigger: Planning UK expansion, raising from UK VCs, applying for FCA authorization

detection_signals: Offering financial services to UK consumers without FCA authorization
Handling client money (CASS rules) without authorization
Operating a payment system without e-money institution authorization
Marketing regulated investments without appropriate authorization
Crypto asset activities requiring FCA registration under 5MLD/MLSR
required_licenses: FCA Authorized Person status (for regulated activities)
e-Money Institution (EMI) authorization for payment accounts
Financial Services Register entry as Appointed Representative (if using AR model)
UK GDPR + Data Protection Act 2018 compliance framework
fix_deliverables: FCA Authorization Roadmap — specific licenses required
Regulated Activity Mapping — what requires authorization
enforcement_cases: FCA v. PayPal UK (2023) — e-money licensing
FCA warnings: 500+ crypto firms removed from UK market (2023-2024)
FCA v. Klarna — consumer duty enforcement (2024)
